column5: FIXED 997a7d797 (report 38940852, correcting report d40f56ac). 13006:146274 "Frame 456", 1318x300, is the flex row that positions the cards and declares gap-[var(--s-2,8px)] = 8px. Its first child 13006:146275 (named "row", 323.5 wide) holds exactly ONE card and declares gap-[var(--s-4,16px)] - a one-child auto-layout gap never renders, so that 16px is unobservable anywhere. An earlier pass read the WRAPPER and moved the page from 8px to 16px. Geometry settles it without trusting either declaration: five cards sit at x = 0, 331.5, 663, 994.5, 1326 on a 323.5px card, a uniform 331.5 pitch, so the gap is 8. And 4 x 323.5 + 3 x 8 = 1318 = the frame content width exactly, which is what makes "four cards at rest" true; at 16px only 3.87 fit, which is what report 38940852 filed. NOT a cap of four: Frame 456 lays out FIVE cards and clips the fifth at its own 1318 boundary, and 13006:146267 carries two 36x36 scroll arrows at x=1236/1282, so the frame is a scroller. slice(0, 12) is correct and unchanged. Guarded in launchpadChrome.figma.test.ts, mutation-checked. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at CHILD depth: get_design_context on 13006:146274 for the declared gap AND the x-offsets of all five cards for the geometric check. The wrapper 13006:146275 was measured separately and is the reason the earlier number was wrong.

FIXED 997a7d797. 13006:146277 is rounded-[var(--rounded-lg,8px)] = 8px. The page shipped `rounded-lg`, which is NOT 8px in this app: the skai-ui preset overrides lg to var(--radius) = 0.75rem = 12px (modules/skai-ui/src/lib/tailwind-preset.ts:394). Converted by NAME, the frame's token lands half again too round. Now the pixel literal rounded-[8px]. The sibling Markets card had already been corrected for this trap (LaunchMarketCard.figma.test.tsx documents it); the trending card was the last use in the family still converting by name. The card corner itself is rounded-[var(--rounded-3xl,24px)] = 24px and `rounded-3xl` does resolve to 24 here, so that one was already right - the trap is confined to lg/xl/2xl, where the preset and Figma stock v3 disagree at every step. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at LEAF depth: get_design_context on 13006:146276 returned the literal class strings for both the card and the image. The radius scale was re-derived from src/index.css --radius plus the preset override, never from the page.

MEASURED, NOT BUILT (reports e1812db0, 6668a306, a3992624, e775cd4f). 13006:146288 Frame 546 (110x16) is `35m` plus FOUR 16px icons/action at x=28, 50, 72, 94 (6px gaps). Identified from the exported SVGs rather than by name: [1] PENCIL/edit, fill #FFBD16 amber; [2] COPY, #95A09F; [3] GLOBE (two ellipses, a meridian, and an M2 7.66663H14 equator), stroked; [4] MAGNIFIER/search, #95A09F. The app draws THREE: Copy, Globe, ExternalLink. So the frame adds edit and search, and has no external-link. NOT BUILT because neither added glyph has a defined target on a third-party discovered token, and an affordance that opens nothing is worse than none. ExternalLink is KEPT per Casey's standing ruling that a frame omitting working behaviour is a crop, not a deletion order. CHAIN BADGE: the frame's trending card has NO chain glyph anywhere (rendered and checked). The app draws networkForChain at the image corner; KEPT under the same ruling, because the Launch list is multi-chain and the badge is the only thing separating a Solana memecoin from a Base one. CORRECTION to the earlier triage, which cited 13006:146491 as a chain glyph beside the contract address on the Markets card: 146491 is the ADDRESS TEXT. The only chain node in the family is 13006:146581, a 16x16 frame named `chain` holding a rounded-rect named `Base`, floating at y=-6 OUTSIDE the row - a detached designer annotation, not a card element. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at LEAF depth: get_metadata to child level, get_design_context for the four asset URLs, then each SVG downloaded and identified by path geometry and fill. Confirmed against a 1350px render for order.

MEASURED (report 66a9f3ef). The node is NOT a settings control, and the report title is misleading. 13006:147305 is a 1382x20 strip at y=0 - the TOKEN TICKER, sibling of the 13006:147304 that LAUNCHPAD_FRAME_FACTS_2026-08-26.md section 2 measured. Its child 13006:147307 (80x12 at x=0, y=4) holds FOUR 12px glyphs with a vertical rule after the first: icons/12px at x=0, then icons/action at x=28, 48 and 68, with a second rule at x=96 separating the cluster from the token list. The first glyph is a GEAR - a small centre circle inside a lobed cog body, the same construction as the 24px 13006:146433. The app mounts TrenchScroller with no controls beside it. NOT BUILT: three of the four still need a defined action before anything is drawn, and the earlier note was right to refuse to invent four icons. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at LEAF depth: get_metadata on 13006:147305 down to glyph level; the flattened SVG for 13006:147307 downloaded and read path by path. Rendered at 1382px.

FIXED 997a7d797 (report 5b900e6e). 13006:146433 exports as a 24x24 viewBox with exactly two paths: a centre circle at (12,12) inside a lobed cog body. That is a GEAR, lucide `Settings`. The page drew `Settings2`, the sliders/faders glyph, which shares nothing with it but a name. The SIZE was already correct and already under test, and that is precisely why this survived a previous pass: the old assertion regexed <Settings2 and so could only ever confirm the size of whatever icon happened to be there. The test now asserts the gear by name and that the faders icon does not come back. The frame also draws the text label "Display settings" (13006:146434) at x=40 inside a 147x32 pill; the app already has it. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at LEAF depth: get_metadata on 13006:146432 for geometry, get_design_context on 13006:146433 for the asset, the SVG downloaded and read, and a 147px render to confirm.

MEASURED, NOT BUILT (report 5f4a4fd2). 13006:146450 Frame 514 is 361x32 at x=957. Label "One-click trade" 79x16 sits outside; the content is 274 wide: Frame 304 (202x32) is images/circle 16x16 at x=8, the placeholder "One click trade" at x=32, the value "0.0" at x=116; Frame 305 (70x32) at x=204 is "P1" at x=16 and "P2" at x=39. TWO answers. [1] The currency mark EXISTS and is a 16px circular coin glyph at the LEADING edge (x=8) - not a text chip, and not trailing the amount. [2] The frame ships P1 ALREADY SELECTED: rendered, P1 is cyan and P2 is grey. NOT BUILT, because default-arming a preset changes what a one-click BUY does on a first visit. That is a money-path behaviour change and Casey's call, not a parity edit. The highlight itself already exists and works (oneClickAmount === p ? text-sky-blue). Note sky-blue is #56C7F3 and is BLUE, per the DO-NOT-REVERT in design-tokens.ts; any note calling it green is stale. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at LEAF depth: get_metadata on 13006:146450 to text level, plus a 361px render to read the selected-state colours, which metadata cannot carry.

MEASURED, NOT MOVED (report d564406c). 13006:146465 "Row" is 1318x124: three 428.67-wide cards with 16px gaps, image 124x124 at x=0, content at x=140. The identity line 13006:146470 (Frame 22) is name + ticker + a 16px icons/action at x=108 - so the frame puts COPY INLINE at the END of the identity line, and its icon row 13006:146477 then carries only THREE glyphs (35m, pencil, globe, magnifier). The app puts Copy in the row below, so its row carries four. This is a MOVE rather than a build, and is deliberately left to the same pass that settles the pencil and search glyphs: moving copy up while the row still shows external-link would be half a conversion. Creator line 13006:146488 is a 16px avatar + @handle + truncated address, with logos/social and a second icons/action both HIDDEN. Bonding bar 13006:146499 is 82x6 in two segments. MEASURED 2026-09-01 at LEAF depth: get_metadata to text level on 13006:146465, plus a 1318px render to identify the glyphs, which the names do not.
